name: shiftkumo-site
description: Marketing website for ShiftKumo, online employee scheduling software (English & Japanese).

scripts.export:cloudflare: node src/build.mjs --cloudflare && mkdir -p exports && rm -f exports/shiftkumo-cloudflare-pages.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../exports/shiftkumo-cloudflare-pages.zip .
scripts.serve: SITE_URL=http://localhost:8080 node src/build.mjs && python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory dist
